minimal_formal_start_gate.precedence: This object is the sole blocking formal-start contract for v1r11 and supersedes every earlier requirement that made the complete thirteen-stage public lifecycle E2E or its receipts a prerequisite to starting the formal teacher. Existing thirteen-stage artifacts remain non-authorizing P2 hardening.

identity_gate.strength_contract: teacher-candidate-generation-whole-parent-fallback-evaluation-training-and-downstream-gates-deep-exact-to-this-plan-and-unchanged-from-v1r10; fallback escalation budgets are an operational admission envelope, not a teacher-label or strength change

minimal_formal_start_gate.formal_teacher_unlock_rule: The formal v1r11 teacher may start from the stable head commit after the one-parent real smoke, identical artifact verifier, identity, focused-regression, and AC/no-sleep gates pass, while PR CI and merge proceed in parallel. Training games and live-weight writes remain locked until CI, regular merge, clean-main tree identity, and existing strength gates pass.

hash4096_is_not_hash8192_teacher_functio.reason: The Hash4096 and Hash8192 probes returned the same cp but different node counts and principal variations, so Hash4096 is not an equivalent substitute for the preregistered Hash8192 teacher function.

staged_authority.first_engine_wording_scope: finalizer-verifier-and-final-LaunchAgent-evidence requirements that say before first engine mean before first formal 8192-parent teacher engine; stage-B preformal probe engines are authorized only by the stage-A receipt

cross_gate_equations: every gate evidence/receipt/ledger row teacher_plan == common.teacher_plan and run_fingerprint == common.run_fingerprint and source_revision == common.source_revision
gate sequence, gate token, primary-source sequence/kind/schema, receipt previous hash, and ledger previous hash exactly follow required_order with no gap duplicate or alternate branch

gate_contracts.primary_source_rule: each gate publishes exactly primary_source_count create-only sources at contiguous source ordinals 01 through count under the fixed gate_artifact_path_rule; kinds and schemas occur in the exact listed order and nested artifact references are full file identities

service_absence_success_semantics.stderr_decoded_bytes_exact_utf8_template:
Bad request.
Could not find service "${label}" in domain for user gui: ${uid}

artifact_verifier_implementation_tests.meaning: Tests the independent artifact-verifier implementation before any preformal or formal execution; this is not the verifier PASS over completed formal artifacts.

preformal_authority_implementation_tests.meaning: Runs the fixed Stage-A/B/C end-to-end test over the trusted semantic producer, seven-row Stage-A prefix receipt, five distinct Stage-B power epochs, gate-13 finalization, independent verification, fault closure, and durable LaunchAgent bindings; the old single-stage test, identity-only evidence, and caller-authored pass artifacts have no gate-5 authority.

independent_artifact_verifier_pass.meaning: After the formal teacher completes, independently verify the completed formal plan, ledger, rows, receipts, hashes, ordering, exact-depth labels, escalation budgets, trusted preformal ledger/raw/verified chain, and durable LaunchAgent evidence bindings before training.

power_continuity_verifier_pass.meaning: Independently verify create-only formal power evidence covers before the first formal 8192-parent engine through after every formal engine is reaped; the runner is the original utility job PID and its exact direct-child caffeinate assertion-holder PID owns every required assertion under the fixed executable and argv; canonical pmset anchors are intact with zero Sleep, DarkWake, Wake, or Hibernate; AC, boot identity, cadence, finalization order, ledger bytes/SHA, verified preformal authority, persistent LaunchAgent evidence, and raw/verified teacher-receipt bindings all pass. On an environment-fault path, the verifier also requires the terminal fault and create-only power ledger/receipt to cross-bind under the non-circular preimage rule.

formal_run_intent_v2.purpose: Compute one stable formal run fingerprint only from artifacts and contracts that exist before the fingerprint; bind later authority receipts without feeding their fingerprint-bearing identities back into the hash.
formal_run_intent_v2.self_reference_rule: No identity whose bytes contain run_fingerprint may be an input to formal_run_intent_v2; in particular live LaunchAgent evidence and raw or verified preformal receipt identities are categorically excluded.

post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.preformal_gate_evidence_ledger_raw_and_v: bind teacher_plan source_revision and the already-computed run_fingerprint but are never hash inputs
post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.launchagent_authority_evidence: bind the already-computed run_fingerprint and exact planned_final_launchagent_descriptor identity plus live process evidence but is never a hash input
post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.teacher_work_header: bind the already-computed run_fingerprint and full identities of launchagent_authority_evidence and preformal_authority_verified_receipt
post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.power_continuity_ledger_and_receipt: bind the already-computed run_fingerprint plus the same LaunchAgent and verified-preformal identities
post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.raw_teacher_receipt: bind the already-computed run_fingerprint and full preformal-ledger raw-preformal verified-preformal LaunchAgent work power-ledger and power-receipt identities
post_fingerprint_cross_bindings.verified_artifact_receipt: independently reauthenticate and bind the same post-fingerprint chain before training handoff

environment_fault_binding.binding_rule: The final guardian row and power receipt bind the canonical runner environment-fault intent (plan, run, verified preformal receipt, LaunchAgent evidence and fault reason; no cleanup claim). After runner/service exit, the same outer supervisor proves rich cleanup, independently recomputes that intent and the held power chain, then alone publishes the final terminal fault binding exact power-ledger, power-receipt and cleanup identities.

sleep_aware_timeout_rejection.reason: The isolated v1r10 G*2a search reached the unchanged normal node cap in 1108533ms and Hash8192 exact depth18 in 9490ms, leaving large margin under 14400000ms. Subtracting sleep would add clock and hibernated-USI-state semantics without improving teacher strength or fixing engine continuity.
